theme_strategy.core_aesthetic: Linear x Notion Aesthetic — Calm-density SaaS
theme_strategy.vibe: A dark-first power tool with a calm, neutral base and high information efficiency. Functional beauty.
theme_strategy.light_mode: Off-white base, clean borders, minimalist. Deeply focused.
theme_strategy.dark_mode: Graphite/Charcoal base. Near-monochrome surfaces with layered elevation via subtle background shifts. Never pure black.

typography.strategy: The Anti-Default Rule. Strictly avoiding Inter, Roboto, and Open Sans. We want a distinctive, modern tech voice.

headings.usage: H1/H2 should feel punchy and editorial but crisp.

body.usage: Highly legible for dense dashboards, kanban boards, and chat threads.

typography.hierarchy_rules: Max heading size is text-5xl on desktop. Do not exceed 2 Tailwind steps between heading and subheading.

rules: Never use pure black #000000 or pure gray #808080. Always tint neutrals.
The Emerald accent is used sparingly: Primary buttons, active states, unread indicator, and high-impact data points.
Always explicitly set text color on hover. (e.g. hover:bg-emerald-600 hover:text-white).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Borderless or near-borderless cards with 1px subtle strokes (border-white/10 in dark mode, border-black/5 in light mode).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used specifically for sticky headers, floating navs, and overlays. Must use backdrop-blur-xl with a tinted background (bg-black/60 or bg-white/70). CRITICAL: NEVER use a fully transparent background for headers, dropdowns, or overlays.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient + direct layered shadows. Soft diffuse shadow for modals, crisp drop-shadows for popovers.
visual_enhancers.focus_states: Visible keyboard focus everywhere. focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-emerald-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_mode: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized.
grids_and_layouts.kanban_mode: Horizontal scrolling flexbox or grid with strict column widths for 'Triage', 'Queue', and 'My Requests'.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy for marketing/auth pages (p-8, p-12). Compact/Dense spacing for the actual ops dashboard (p-4, p-6).
grids_and_layouts.mobile: Mobile-first responsive. Use a bottom tab bar on mobile screens (fixed bottom-0 w-full border-t bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-md pb-safe z-50).

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md) with crisp text. Emerald primary buttons.
component_guidelines.inputs: Shadcn standard but styled with focus-visible:ring-emerald-500. Add subtle inner shadow on light mode.
component_guidelines.modals_dropdowns: CRITICAL: Dropdown menus, tooltips, and dialogs MUST have a solid or highly-opaque glass background. No pure transparency.
component_guidelines.tabs: Shadcn Tabs. Override fixed heights like h-9 to h-auto to prevent cutoff.
component_guidelines.icons: Use lucide-react. Keep icon sizes consistent (w-4 h-4 for inline, w-5 h-5 for primary actions).

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Buttons lift slightly (-translate-y-[1px]).
motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform. NEVER use 'transition: all'.
motion.lists: Staggered entrance animations for kanban cards and inbox items.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: APCA preferred. Normal text min 4.5:1. Never grey-on-grey.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (kebab-case, role-based). Example: data-testid='submit-request-button', data-testid='request-status-badge'.

screen_by_screen_guidance.auth: Minimalist centered card. 'Creative Hub'. Smooth JWT login/signup. Glassmorphic card over a subtle abstract Emerald texture background.
screen_by_screen_guidance.dashboard_home: Executive view. Top KPI metrics, active blockers list, WIP per user charts. Dense, readable.
screen_by_screen_guidance.all_my_requests: Table or Kanban-esque list. Filter tabs at the top. Each card shows status, requester, @mentions snippet.
screen_by_screen_guidance.new_request_form: Multi-step or clean single-page form. Drag-and-drop file upload zone (max 5x5MB) with image previews.
screen_by_screen_guidance.request_detail: Split view. Left: Brief, reference images, delivery link. Right: Activity/Comment thread. Sticky action bar (Approve/Redesign/Deliver) at bottom or top right.
screen_by_screen_guidance.triage_queue: Master queue list with drag-to-rank functionality. 'High Importance' flags in Emerald or distinct alert color.
screen_by_screen_guidance.inbox: In-app notification center. Unread count pill. Clear distinct unread states (subtle emerald background tint). Click-to-navigate.
screen_by_screen_guidance.admin_panel: Dense table view for user role management and channel list editing.

abstract_emerald_texture.description: A soothing abstract gradient of green tones, perfect for minimalist design.

creative_workspace.description: An art studio desk with brushes and watercolors showcasing a creative workspace.

instructions_to_main_agent.file_extensions: Use .js or .jsx exclusively. Do not generate .tsx files. You are working with JavaScript React.
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn_customization: Do not blindly copy Shadcn components. Strip the default 'Vercel-look' and apply the Notion/Linear styling (subtle borders, specific shadows, Emerald accent).
instructions_to_main_agent.state_management: Use React Context or similar for JWT auth state and multi-role scoping.
instructions_to_main_agent.empty_states: Ensure every data-fetching screen has a meticulously designed empty, loading (skeleton), and error state.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur), but never pure transparent backgrounds behind text.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container globally. Maintain natural left-aligned reading flow.
NEVER use emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭 for icons. Use lucide-react.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute.
Missing image categories = use the provided URLs. Do not use placeholder text.
